testCases.title: Guests page loads successfully after authentication
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
steps: Verify top action bar is present
testCases.expectedResult: Page loads without errors, header shows 'Guests', sidebar navigation is accessible, and action bar is visible

testCases.title: Guest listing displays correct data from database
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
Database contains at least 3 guest records
steps: Verify each guest row contains: name, room number, check-in date, check-out date, status
Verify total guest count matches database records
testCases.expectedResult: All guest records are displayed with accurate data, correct column headers, and matching total count

testCases.title: Navigation to guest detail page from listing
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
At least one guest record exists
steps: Locate a guest record in the listing
Click on the guest name or row
Verify guest detail page loads with full information
Verify back navigation returns to listing
testCases.expectedResult: Guest detail page loads successfully showing complete guest information including personal details, booking info, and stay history

testCases.title: Check-in guest from guest detail page
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
At least one guest has 'Confirmed' status
steps: Click on a guest with 'Confirmed' status
Verify guest status changes to 'Checked In'
testCases.expectedResult: Guest is successfully checked in, status updates to 'Checked In', check-in timestamp is recorded, and success message is displayed

testCases.title: Empty state displayed when no guests exist
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
No guest records exist in the system
steps: Verify empty state illustration is displayed
Verify message 'No guests found' or similar is shown
Verify 'Add Guest' or 'New Guest' button is visible
testCases.expectedResult: Empty state is properly displayed with appropriate messaging and CTA button for adding new guests

testCases.title: Search with special characters and no results
preconditions: User is logged in at /auth with valid employee credentials
Guest records exist in the system
steps: Enter special characters (e.g., '@#$%') in search field
Enter non-existent name (e.g., 'xyz123') in search field
Verify appropriate 'No results found' message is displayed
Verify full guest listing is restored
testCases.expectedResult: Search handles special characters gracefully without errors, displays 'no results' message for invalid queries, and restores full listing when search is cleared
